findings.title: Trace, record, and narration
findings.claim: The focus word آثارهم can hold the departed group's remaining trace as the first readable residue of a scene that later becomes record, sign, and sequential report.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier is the remaining-trace facet of آثارهم; the supplied record, visible sign, and ordered recounting in 18:9 and 18:13 give that residue inscriptional and narrative contacts, so absence becomes recoverable through marks and telling.
findings.reader_payoff: The addressee's grief is seen at the point where a vanishing group is still followed by what can be read and retold.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-local preservation image, not a claim that آثارهم lexically means inscription or that the whole surah is governed by this image.

epistemic.reason: The reviewed nomination is trusted and every nominated branch has an exact focus or lean-context occurrence, but the source remains a candidate synthesis rather than an independent lexical verdict.
